messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — surge of 5xx + fallback activations for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error rate: 18% (baseline 0.3%). Smart-routing shows repeated region fallback to eu-west-1. Paging oncall.
Anna (oncall): acked. jumping in. seeing alerts in grafana — latency also climbing. sourcing traces now.
Anna (oncall): @Jordan can you join? looks like fallback policy is driving traffic cross-region.
Jordan (sre): on it. pulled routing logs: smart-routing decided model-variant `redwood-2q-int8` unavailable in us-west-2 and started failing over to eu-west-1. eu-west has limited capacity so then fallback sent back -> loop detected. also seeing lots of client 5xx retries flooding the edge.
Kim (runtime): hmm — we recently pushed a policy tweak that prioritizes region fallback over degraded variants. might be the change. checking recent deploys.
Maria (devex): heads-up: some clients (mobile SDK) have aggressive retry backoff (0, 200ms, 500ms) and don't respect 429s. if server responds 5xx they immediately retry which doubles requests.
Anna (oncall): customer impact: several high-usage tenants in us-west are reporting timeouts. Notifying CS.
pager-duty-bot: Incident severity set to S2 due to multiple customers affected and cross-region traffic spike.
Jordan (sre): mitigation suggestion: temporarily disable inter-region fallback policy and enable local degraded-variant acceptance (serve lower-capacity model variant in us-west) to stop churn. Also add short-term rate-limit at edge for retries.
Kim (runtime): I can flip the policy flag. Need approval and will make a single-line config change: `routing.fallback.policy = ":local-variant-first"` — current value `":region-first"`.
Anna (oncall): do it. coordinate with Jordan for edge limits. post the exact command here before you run.
Kim (runtime): running rollback: `rkctl config set routing.fallback.policy local-variant-first --env prod --region us-west-2` — pushing now.
Kim (runtime): done. change rolled. publishing to live within ~30s.
Jordan (sre): adding rate-limit rule at API edge: `rlmgr add-rule --match "/v1/generate" --client-retries 3 --burst 20 --rate 50/s --region us-west-2` — applied.
Maria (devex): spinning a short note to integrators channel asking clients to implement exponential backoff and respect 429. Suggested header: `X-Redwood-Retry-After` with recommended backoff values.
Anna (oncall): monitoring metrics: error rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in 45s. latency still high, but trending down.
Jordan (sre): extra check: finding influx of requests with `X-Retry-Id` repeated. looks like some SDKs weren't de-duplicating retries after failover. I'll push a temporary dedupe at the gateway: `gw.dedupe-window=1s`.
Kim (runtime): dedupe enabled in us-west edge. that should cut duplicate fanout.
Anna (oncall): can someone confirm that eu-west-1 isn't being overwhelmed? I see CPU on a handful of hosts close to 90%.
Jordan (sre): eu-west load stabilized after rollback, but we were close. spun up 2 extra spillover workers in eu-west as safety: `orch scale model-worker=+2 --region eu-west-1`.
Maria (devex): created a customer-facing status note draft: short, transparent, mention mitigation and ask clients to update SDK backoff. linking to draft: https://go/status/inc-2109876543 (internal).
Anna (oncall): handoff: I'm going to run the on-call for 30 more minutes then hand to Jordan. Jordan, you take next shift if still noisy.
Jordan (sre): will monitor for 2 hours. also creating an alert for retry amplification: alert if retry-rate / successful-requests > 0.25 for 5m.
Kim (runtime): quick root cause note: the recent policy flip to region-first meant we preferred regional failover rather than allow local degraded variants. when local variant was briefly failing (OOM on a small pool), policy forced cross-region fallback and clients retried -> cascading traffic bounce. will prepare a config safeguard.
Anna (oncall): good. next steps: 1) leave routing policy local-variant-first for now 2) make retry amplification alert 3) add automated throttle on inter-region fallback 4) ensure SDKs get backoff guidance & header. assign owners.
Jordan (sre): owners: routing flag -> Kim; gateway dedupe & rate-limits -> Jordan; alerts -> Anna; SDK notice -> Maria.
Anna (oncall): updating incident board. CS notified customers A,B,C with personalized notes. no evidence of data loss, only availability impact.
Kim (runtime): opening PR to add a safety check in the rollout that prevents `region-first` if local-variant health < 50% without a cooldown: `checks/local-variant-cooldown`.
Maria (devex): linking to SDK PR with revised retry policy and tests. asking docs to push a small blurb in quickstart.
Anna (oncall): metrics now: errors at 2.1%, latency down 40% from peak. good. I'll close initial page once we stabilize for 30m.
Jordan (sre): filing postmortem stub, will include timeline, config diff, and proposed follow-ups.
Anna (oncall): thanks team. leaving this thread for ongoing notes. tag me if it re-escalates. :thumbsup:
pager-duty-bot: On-call handoff: Anna -> Jordan at 2109877200.
Jordan (sre): acknowledged handoff. continuing monitoring. final note: revisit client retry defaults with product — we'll aim for 500ms jittered exponential by default.
